name: Atashin'chi
description: A light hearted comedy based on the about the daily life of a "normal" Japanese family. The Tachibana family consists of a housewife mom, a salary-man dad, and teenager Mikan and Yuzuhiko.

videos.title: I'm Saying, That's Not It! / Don't Be Scared!
I Shouldn't Have Said That / Come Home!
How To Eat Things Like Bread Crusts / Mother's Sense of Justice
Mom, Your Eyes are Hazy? / The Spirit is Unnaturalized
It's Mom Again? / Father Likes That
Mikan, Give Up Being a Human / Yuzu, As Usual
Mom Can't Throw It Away / Yuzu is a Natto Expert
Yuzu and Mayonnaise
videos.overview: Yuzu gets hungry at night and has an incident with mayonnaise.

videos.title: Underwear Maketh Woman?
videos.overview: Mikan discusses what makes a woman pretty.

videos.title: Mother's Selective Brain
videos.overview: Mother has problems recalling things, unless under specific circumstances...

videos.title: Yuzu's Off Switch
videos.overview: Yuzu 'turns off' his thought process which leads to forgetting various things.

videos.title: Father buys a computer
videos.overview: Father buys a computer and proceeds to have various issues with it.

videos.title: Mikan, nap time!
videos.overview: Mikan discusses her problems sleeping, including just taking a "Small nap" before getting back to her homework.

videos.title: Mother Likes Bargains
videos.overview: Episode 195: Mother discusses her bargain shopping for clothes.

videos.title: Summer Break Organizing
videos.overview: Mother wants to clean the house while father is away. Her children are very reluctant to help.

videos.title: Come when you're called!
videos.overview: Mother is annoyed when her children won't respond right away when called for dinner.

videos.title: I'm Late!
videos.overview: Mikan is repeatedly late for her dentist appointment.

videos.title: A Future Comedian
videos.overview: Mikan discusses her future potential at being a comedian.

videos.title: So Noisy!
videos.overview: A loud television causes problems for Mikan and Mother.

videos.title: Chichimawasu?
videos.overview: Hearing strange dialect, Mikan is determined to figure out what "Chichimawasu" means!  (For the purpose of this episode, the English title is in romanji)

videos.title: Christmas For The Bear Brigade
videos.overview: Mikan has to get a Christmas gift for her friends on a set budget.

videos.title: Father Struggles with a Pain Relief Patch
Mikan, do I look ugly?
videos.overview: After a couple get together, Mikan and her friends begin to wonder what makes a woman beautiful to men.

videos.title: The Air Conditioner is Broken
videos.overview: A broken air conditioner leads to many bizarre situations in the intense heat.

videos.title: Mikan Is Stiff
videos.overview: Falling asleep in her chair, Mikan finds herself waking up with a stiff back which causes many problems throughout the day.

videos.title: Mother Tries to Remember Someone
videos.overview: At a supermarket, mother encounters a familiar face and struggles to recall who she is.

videos.title: Mikan Wants to Eat More
videos.overview: Mikan is hungry at school and wants to eat plenty of food, but wants to watch her calories.

videos.title: Yuzuhiko's Mechanical Pencil
videos.overview: Kawashima admires Yuzuhiko's cherished mechanical pencil. Kawashima purchases the same mechanical pencil but isn't satisfied and eventually eyes Yuzuhiko's mechanical pencil.

videos.title: Mikan's Handmade Hamburger Steak
videos.overview: Mother is off on a two-day trip with friends and with Mikan in charge of dinner, she shows off her skills, determined to make a good meal. How will Father and Yuzuhiko react?

videos.title: Jogging with Mother
videos.overview: Mother accepts the fact that exercise is very important for your health. She resolves to start jogging but runs into a couple of obstacles along the way...

videos.title: Father's Drowsy Drive
videos.overview: Mother and Father are on the road. On the highway, Father is drowsy, so Mother tries to keep him awake in any way she can. What's the ultimate solution?

videos.title: Mikan's Student ID Photo
videos.overview: It's hard to look good in a photo. Mikan and her classmates are taking student ID photos and everyone is trying to look good. How will the photos turn out?

videos.title: Yuzuhiko and a Melon
videos.overview: Yuzuhiko, in awe at the rare sight of a melon at home, comes up with the ultimate plan to eat a whole melon himself...

videos.title: Mother and Father's Hectic One-Night Trip
videos.overview: Mother and Father visit a hot spring. On the way, Mother wants to check out some must-see spots. Afterwards at the the inn, they find themselves in a bit of hot water.

videos.title: Bathroom Dreams
videos.overview: Mikan and the Teddy Bear Brigade are chatting away about "bathroom dreams." What kind of strange dreams did they have?

videos.title: Kawashima's Lonely Summer Break
videos.overview: Kawashima is sad she can't see Yuzuhiko, so she rides her bike around the neighborhood, hoping to run into him. Meanwhile, Yuzuhiko happens to be shopping nearby.

videos.title: Going to the Movies With Iwaki
videos.overview: Hearing news that Yoshioka and Iwaki are going to watch a movie together, Mikan wants to tag along while Shimizu doesn't. They share their inner thoughts via "telepathy."
